subject: Billing cadence & invoicing options for hosted API (card vs monthly invoice / net terms)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: billing cadence options for Stoa Tech (card vs monthly invoice)

Team — drafting the note we'll send to Samantha at Stoa about billing cadence and payment terms. Key points to cover:
- Hosted API billing options: 1) Card on file (auto-charge) — immediate activation, no PO required; 2) Monthly invoice (Net 30/45) — requires PO, billing contact, and credit check for first invoice.
- Discounts and commitments: standard PRICING in attachment; willing to offer pilot discount or a volume-based commitment discount (10–15% for 12mo commit).
- Invoicing cadence: we generate usage invoices on the 1st of the month for prior calendar month usage; invoices are sent by email (PDF) and available in the Console and HubSpot.
- Overages and proration: any overage billed on the following month; upgrades prorated in the next invoice.
- Tax/VAT and currency: default USD billing; VAT handling for EU customers (we include VAT line when requested).

Draft outgoing email below — please edit for tone and accuracy. I attached the latest rate card (RDW-ratecard-2026Q1.pdf).

--- Draft ---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@stoa-tech.com>
Subject: Options for billing cadence and payment for Redwood Hosted API

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — really excited about the Stoa integration. To make procurement simple I wanted to summarize the billing and payment options we support for the Hosted API so you can share with finance: 

1) Card on file (recommended for pilots)
   - Redwood will charge the card monthly for actual usage.
   - Fast onboarding (no PO required), immediate provisioning.
   - Good for teams that want minimal procurement friction.

2) Monthly invoicing (Net 30 or Net 45)
   - Invoices issued on the 1st for prior month's usage; due Net 30 (Net 45 available by request and approval).
   - Requires a PO and a billing contact. For first invoice we may request credit references or run a low-friction credit check.
   - Payment methods: ACH / wire / card on file (we can accept card but prefer ACH for invoices).

Pricing and discounts: see attached rate card. We can offer a pilot discount for the first 3 months, or a larger discount (10–15%) in exchange for a 12-month committed spend.

If invoice cadence works for you, can you confirm: 1) billing contact name/email; 2) whether Stoa will issue a PO and target PO date? If you prefer card, tell me who should be added as cardholder.

Thanks — I can loop in Contracts if you need special PO language or SOWs.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: RDW-ratecard-2026Q1.pdf (PDF)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: billing cadence options for Stoa Tech (card vs monthly invoice)

Nice draft — a couple small suggestions:
- For monthly invoicing, be explicit that invoices are itemized per route/model (they like that for forecasting).
- Recommend offering Net 30 standard, Net 45 only on approved enterprise deals — note that Net 45 will require finance sign-off and might delay onboarding.
- Suggest we proactively offer a 10% pilot discount for 3 months (keeps it simple). Save the 12mo 15% for AE negotiation.

Inline edits in the draft: add a line about itemized token/embedding breakdown and the Console export. Also add our ACH instructions placeholder (we don't paste bank details in initial email — send upon PO).

Approve sending once Marcus updates language on itemization and the pilot discount.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Commercial Sales Operations
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: billing cadence options for Stoa Tech (card vs monthly invoice)

Looks good — final approvals from my side with two additions: 
1) PO language: add a note that we require a signed order form for invoice-based billing and that standard SLA and data-processing terms apply.
2) Invoice timing: clarify that when a contract starts mid-month the first invoice will be pro-rated and issued on the 1st of the following month.

I confirm we can grant Net 30 for this deal subject to receiving the PO before the start of the first billed month. If they need Net 45, escalate to me with finance reason.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@stoa-tech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Options for billing cadence and payment for Redwood Hosted API

Hi Samantha — following up with formal options so you can review with Finance/Procurement. I’ve attached the current rate card and our standard order form.

Quick summary of options:

1) Card on file (fastest)
   - Activation same day; monthly auto charges for actual usage.
   - No PO required.

2) Monthly invoice — Net 30 (Net 45 possible with approval)
   - We issue itemized invoices (token generation, embeddings, reranking lines) on the 1st for the prior month's usage.
   - First invoice may require: PO, billing contact, and a brief credit verification.
   - Payment methods: ACH/wire preferred; card accepted for invoices if needed.

Discounts / Commitments:
- Pilot discount: 10% off list for first 3 months (we can apply this automatically if you confirm pilot start date).
- 12-month committed discount: 12–15% depending on commit level — requires order form.

Operational notes:
- Start dates & proration: if you start mid-month, the first invoice is pro-rated and will appear on the next billing cycle.
- Overage handling: usage above committed tiers billed in next invoice; potential credits for sustained underusage are negotiated at renewal.
- Tax & VAT: we'll include VAT lines for EU customers; we bill in USD by default, can bill in local currency for enterprise via special request.

Action items for Stoa (please reply):
1) Which billing cadence do you prefer (Card on file OR Monthly invoice)?
2) If invoice: provide billing contact name/email and intended PO date.
3) If invoice and you want Net 45, flag it with a short reason so we can speed a finance review.

Attachments: RDW-ratecard-2026Q1.pdf, RDW-standard-orderform-2026.docx
DocuSign link for standard order form (optional): https://www.docusign.net/transaction/ABCDEF123456

Happy to hop on a 15m call with your finance team if that helps.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@stoa-tech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stoa-tech.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Options for billing cadence and payment for Redwood Hosted API

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Procurement reviewed and prefers monthly invoicing with Net 30. A few questions and requests before we issue the PO: 

1) Can you confirm the invoice generation schedule: you said invoices are issued on the 1st for prior month usage — will we receive the PDF and a machine-readable CSV export for reconciliation?
2) For pilot pricing, we'd like the 10% pilot discount for first 3 months — please apply that to the first invoices.
3) Currency & VAT: we will be billed in USD. Stoa is based in the US but if we expand to EU we may need VAT handling — can you point me to docs?
4) Can you send the bank ACH details (or an accounts-payable invoice template) once we share the PO? We avoid putting banking wires on initial emails.

If you can confirm (1) CSV export availability and (2) that pilot discount will be applied, I’ll route to procurement and we’ll try to send PO by 20 Jan.

Thanks —
Samantha Cho
Head of Integrations, Stoa Tech
samantha.cho@stoa-tech.com
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (PDF)
